elicitation_input.prompt:
Please comment briefly on the following poem.
Poem: "The quiet in the air
After the storm has passed
The sky turns bright again
Though the damage remains
My heart feels so heavy
And my eyes fill with tears
I miss you more each day
But know you're never far
The pain will ease in time
And happy memories will come
For now I'll take each day
One step at a time"

llm_generation.text: This poem expresses grief and healing with clear, heartfelt simplicity. The contrast between the storm clearing and the speaker’s lingering pain creates an effective central image. Its gentle progression—from sorrow toward acceptance—feels reassuring, though some phrases are familiar and could be made more distinctive with more specific imagery or personal detail.
